faq_heading: Homes near Boundary Park Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Boundary Park Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Boundary Park Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Boundary Park Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Boundary Park Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Beaver Creek Elementary (0.4 km north), J T Brown Elementary (0.7 km south-east) and Tamanawis Secondary (0.9 km north-east).

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Boundary Park Elementary

26 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Boundary Park Elementary in a straight line (20 elementary, 5 secondary, 1 other; 4 independent). The closest is Beaver Creek Elementary, 0.4 km away, and the farthest on this list is Westerman Elementary, 2.7 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Tamanawis Secondary (0.9 km); the nearest independent school is Khalsa School Newton (1.4 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Ecole Panorama Ridge Secondary (1.9 km). Other elementary schools close by: Beaver Creek Elementary (0.4 km north), J T Brown Elementary (0.7 km south-east), Panorama Park Elementary (1.1 km east), Pinewood Elementary (1.1 km west), Khalsa School Newton (1.4 km north). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Beaver Creek Elementary, 0.4 km north of Boundary Park Elementary.
